name: roadster-rocket
description: Roadster Rocket - a 3D flying roadster stunt game for the browser.

scripts.models: npm run models:car && npm run models:vehicles
scripts.models:car: /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P blender/roadster.py -- blender/out/roadster.glb && npx --yes @gltf-transform/cli meshopt blender/out/roadster.glb public/models/roadster.glb --level medium
scripts.models:vehicles: /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P blender/vehicles.py -- blender/out/vehicles.glb && npx --yes @gltf-transform/cli meshopt blender/out/vehicles.glb public/models/vehicles.glb --level medium
